name: Cumulonimbus and Cumulus Shape Generation
definition: Procedural generation of non-spherical, multi-lobed cloud shapes for Cumulus (type 9) and Cumulonimbus (type 10) clouds, creating irregular tops and bases rather than simple spheres.
summary: Cumulonimbus and Cumulus Shape Generation is a procedural method that creates irregular, multi-lobed cloud structures for volume rendering by generating lists of 3D ellipsoidal lobes rather than simple spheres.
